lessons.title: What Is Sound? Feel the Vibration
lessons.focus: Touch a drummed ngoma skin, a humming throat, a struck ruler on a desk; sound = vibration traveling.
lessons.advanced: Explain why the ruler's pitch rises as you shorten the overhang: link length to vibration rate.

lessons.title: Sound Needs a Medium
lessons.focus: Sound through a desk, through string, not through vacuum; bell-in-a-bottle pump demo attempt; Moon is silent.
lessons.advanced: Argue from particle collisions why sound dies as air is removed; what remains in a perfect vacuum?

lessons.title: Waves Carry Energy, Not Stuff
lessons.focus: Ripples in a basin move a leaf in place; rope transverse vs spring longitudinal waves; wave anatomy drawn.
lessons.advanced: Label crest, trough, wavelength, amplitude on your rope sketch; distinguish wave speed from particle motion.

lessons.title: Wavelength, Frequency, Amplitude and v = fλ
lessons.focus: Count rope waves per second, measure wavelength with chalk; v = fλ for rope and sound.
lessons.advanced: Sound: f=170 Hz, λ=2 m — compute wave speed; predict λ for a drum's 85 Hz.

lessons.title: Measuring the Speed of Sound with an Echo
lessons.focus: Clap toward a far wall; time the echo over known distance; average ten claps; compare with ~340 m/s.
lessons.advanced: Wall 85 m away, echo in 0.5 s: compute speed and the reaction-time error; improve the method.

lessons.title: Build: The Bottle Xylophone I
lessons.focus: Water level sets pitch; six bottles tuned by ear to a scale; striking vs blowing gives different families.
lessons.advanced: Explain why more water raises the struck pitch but lowers the blown pitch (solid vs air column vibrating).

lessons.title: Build: The Bottle Xylophone II — Tune and Play
lessons.focus: Tune against a reference (phone app or teacher ear); play a known tune; record the water levels.
lessons.advanced: If level-to-pitch were linear in air column, would equal water steps make equal note steps? Investigate.

lessons.title: Build: The One-String Guitar I
lessons.focus: Wire/fishing line on a board with bottle bridge; tension by hanging stone; pluck and measure pitch vs length.
lessons.advanced: Predict the half-length pitch using f∝1/L; verify against a tuner app.

lessons.title: Build: The One-String Guitar II — Ratios and Songs
lessons.focus: Find octave (1/2), fifth (2/3), fourth (3/4) positions; mark frets; play with the bottle xylophone ensemble.
lessons.advanced: Derive fret positions from f∝1/L for a pentatonic scale; mark them with measured distances.

lessons.title: Drums: The Physics of the Ngoma
lessons.focus: Tight skin = high pitch; size matters; warming a drum by the fire tightens skin; membrane modes teaser.
lessons.advanced: Explain with tension and wave speed why tightening raises pitch; estimate direction of change with numbers.
